integrity: Full finite enumeration by point-to-line permutation test and separate six-cycle-flip backtracking implementation; complete adjacency and distance certificate embedded. Earlier graph structure and known Fano matching counts are credited.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact classification for the Fano-plane Heawood graph only; uses the published uniqueness of the 24-vertex distance-regular graph with intersection array {7,4,1;1,2,7}. Does not extend to larger incidence planes or other move definitions. Equivalent descriptions in difficult-to-search older graph literature may exist. No independent scholarly audit has been performed.
title: The Heawood hexagon-flip graph is the 24-vertex Klein graph
